title: Triangles and quadrilaterals
summary: Sort triangles by their sides and angles, meet the quadrilateral family, and draw the diagonals of a rhombus.
guide: This studio is for Years 4 and 5. Like many textbooks, it works on dotty paper.

Triangles have two kinds of name. By sides: {{term:equilateral-triangle}} (three equal sides), {{term:isosceles-triangle}} (at least two equal sides) and {{term:scalene-triangle}}. By angles: {{term:acute-angled-triangle}}, {{term:right-angled-triangle}} and {{term:obtuse-angled-triangle}}. A triangle can be right-angled and isosceles at the same time.
On dotty paper, a slanted side that goes "2 across, 1 up" is the same length as one that goes "1 across, 2 up". That helps to spot equal sides on tilted triangles.

Quadrilaterals form a family: a {{term:square-shape}} is a {{term:rectangle}} (four right angles) and also a {{term:rhombus}} (four equal sides). Rectangles and rhombuses are both {{term:parallelogram}}s. In this studio a {{term:trapezium}} has exactly one pair of parallel sides, as in Iran's books. The {{term:diagonal}}s of a rhombus cross at right angles and cut each other in half.

engine.letters: A B C D E F G H I J
engine.instruction-draw: Tap the dots. Then tap the first dot.
engine.instruction-line: Tap two dots to draw a segment.

find-isosceles.title: Isosceles triangles
find-isosceles.prompt: Tap every {{term:isosceles-triangle}}: the triangles with at least two equal sides.
find-isosceles.hint: For slanted sides, count: how many across and how many up? "2 and 1" is the same length as "1 and 2". An isosceles triangle can be tilted or right-angled.
find-isosceles.success: Well done! The orange, green and purple triangles each have two equal sides. The green one is tilted and the purple one has a right angle, but both are isosceles.
find-isosceles.why: How do you know two sides of the green triangle are equal? They are slanted!
find-isosceles.model: One side goes 2 across and 1 up, the other goes 1 across and 2 up. It is the same step turned round, so the two sides are the same length.

feedback.not-equal-sides: One triangle you tapped has three different side lengths: it is a {{term:scalene-triangle}}. Count its sides. Tap it again to take it back.
feedback.extra: One triangle you tapped does not have two equal sides. Tap it again to take it back.
feedback.missed: There is another isosceles triangle. Look at the tilted one and the one with a right angle too.

right-isosceles.title: Right-angled and isosceles
right-isosceles.prompt: Draw a triangle that is both a {{term:right-angled-triangle}} and an {{term:isosceles-triangle}}.
right-isosceles.hint: First make a right angle: one side across and one side straight up. Then make the two sides next to the right angle the same length.
right-isosceles.success: Well done! It has a right angle and the two sides next to it are equal, so it has both names.
right-isosceles.why: Can a triangle be right-angled and equilateral? Why?
right-isosceles.model: No. In an equilateral triangle all the angles are equal, and none of them is a right angle. But right-angled and isosceles can go together, like this one.

feedback.empty: Tap the dots to draw a triangle.
feedback.open: Your shape is still open. Tap the first dot to close it.
feedback.crossed: The sides cross over each other. Draw it again.
feedback.too-many-sides: A triangle has only three sides. Press Clear and try again.
feedback.too-few-sides: You need three dots that are not in a straight line.
feedback.not-right-angled: Your triangle has no right angle: there is no little square mark. Draw one side across and one side straight up.
feedback.not-isosceles: You have a right angle, well done! But the two sides next to it are not the same length. Look at the numbers by the sides.

find-rectangles.title: The rectangle family
find-rectangles.prompt: Tap every {{term:rectangle}}: the quadrilaterals with four right angles.
find-rectangles.hint: Count the right-angle marks. A shape with four right angles is a rectangle, even if its sides are equal or it is tilted.
find-rectangles.success: Well done! All three are rectangles. A {{term:square-shape}} is a rectangle too: a rectangle with equal sides.
find-rectangles.why: Your friend says, "A square is not a rectangle, because its sides are equal." What would you say?
find-rectangles.model: A rectangle is a quadrilateral with four right angles. A square has four right angles, so it is a rectangle. It just has one more property: its sides are equal too.

feedback.no-right-angles: The blue shape is a {{term:parallelogram}}: its opposite sides are parallel, but its corners are not right angles. So it is not a rectangle.
feedback.extra: One shape you tapped does not have four right angles. Tap it again to take it back.
feedback.missed: There is another rectangle. A square is a rectangle too, even when it is tilted. Count its corners.

draw-trapezium.title: Draw a trapezium
draw-trapezium.prompt: Draw a {{term:trapezium}}: a quadrilateral with exactly one pair of parallel sides.
draw-trapezium.hint: Draw two sides across of different lengths, one at the top and one at the bottom. Then join their ends.
draw-trapezium.success: Well done! Two opposite sides are parallel and the other two are not. That is a trapezium.
draw-trapezium.why: How is your shape different from a {{term:parallelogram}}?
draw-trapezium.model: A parallelogram has both pairs of opposite sides parallel. My trapezium has only one parallel pair, because the top and bottom are different lengths.

feedback.empty: Tap the dots to draw a quadrilateral.
feedback.open: Your shape is still open. Tap the first dot to close it.
feedback.crossed: The sides cross over each other. Tap the dots in order round the shape.
feedback.too-many-sides: A trapezium has four sides. Press Clear and try again.
feedback.too-few-sides: A trapezium has four sides. You need one more dot.
feedback.not-trapezium: None of your sides are parallel. Draw a top side and a bottom side that both go straight across.
feedback.is-parallelogram: Both pairs of opposite sides are parallel: that is a {{term:parallelogram}}. Make the top side shorter or longer than the bottom.

rhombus-diagonals.title: Diagonals of a rhombus
rhombus-diagonals.prompt: This shape is a {{term:rhombus}}. {{term:diagonal}} AC is drawn. Draw the other diagonal, BD.
rhombus-diagonals.hint: A diagonal goes from one corner to the opposite corner. Tap B, then D.
rhombus-diagonals.success: Well done! The two diagonals meet in the middle of the rhombus and make four right angles.
rhombus-diagonals.why: Where and how do the two diagonals cross?
rhombus-diagonals.model: They meet halfway along both, so they cut each other in half. They cross at right angles: AC goes 1 across for 1 up, and BD goes 1 across for 1 down. In every rhombus the diagonals are perpendicular.

feedback.empty: Tap two corners to draw a diagonal.
feedback.not-through: The diagonal must go from corner B to the opposite corner, D. Press Clear and try again.
feedback.not-perpendicular: Your segment is not perpendicular to AC. Go from B to D.
